reviews.text: This is crazy but I at up an account with them years ago. I can still log in but the password has been compromised. Now that it is, I’d like to change my password so that someone doesn’t use my credits, account etc. but there’s literally no way to change it or even to contact support. I work in tech at one of the big tech companies so I have a pretty good sense of how to navigate a variety of UXs. This one is a mess.

reviews.title: Took my money
reviews.text: I was trying to send one Fax it kept trying to charge me 4999 then I tried six faxes. It kept trying to charge me 4999 and I never ended up still charge me and now I have to fight with Apple to get my refund, I would not recommend this to anyone and I never had a problem with Genius Scan ever but with Genius Fax, they take your money and they don’t provide even if you don’t use it, which I don’t think is fair if I use the product, then I’ll pay for it but I Fax and I was still charged and I don’t have a lot of money and I’m a single mother with two kids and I’m on disability and now I have to fight with my bank and Genius Fax and Apple for my money back I do not think it’s fair at all!!! will never use this product again!!!
